limits: Prepare-only: one configured WeaponTemp part3112012. Seven GLBs are isolated original serialized inputs, not seven equipped parts or seven recovered final forms.
Original active/enabled flags retained in source reports, but actual visibility/morph is rule-controlled. Do not display all source inputs stacked and claim the source instance.
main is the separate serialized base skin, not a claim of complete default star appearance. Four static blade inputs and two static FX inputs have no invented rigs.
Original star digits, colors/shape/randomness, shader execution, GPU morph, particle effects and presentation switching have NOT been executed or reconstructed.
RGBAHalf/Float numeric texture data are exact GPU bytes plus bit-preserving NPY with dtype/shape/row-order/mips. Their PNGs are display conversions only and cannot replace source numeric data.
Ordinary source PNG dimensions/channels retained. No guessed packed ORM, source grip, rescale, new bones, current gameplay integration, browser or screenshots.
Any non-unit NORMAL/TANGENT shader inputs are retained in additional NPY/raw source evidence and omitted as invalid glTF direction attributes; source positions/UV/topology remain unchanged.

Original Unity rootBone of the main skin is not an ancestor of every palette joint. The optional glTF skeleton field alone is omitted; original source rootBone PPtr/node remains in sourceBinding.source_original_root_bone, with no hierarchy/joint/SRT/IBM changes.

package_validation.method: No game/source reread. Actual GLB accessors/topology/weights/joints/IBMs, embedded PNG SHA, CPU source proofs, Khronos errors0 and original-size PNG SHA checked.

original_precision_validation.semantics: All declared source attributes preserved in raw/layout/type evidence, all IEEE base-level bytes preserved bit-exact, all additional files within4MiB; no packed shader interpretation.
